title: Grateful Dead Live at Field House - University of Cincinnati on 1970-04-03

ai_review.summary: Soundboard source with minor pitch and pop issues but captures a solid 1970 set featuring an acoustic segment, standout The Other One and Lovelight.
ai_review.review: The recording is a sound‑board capture that suffers from a half‑step low pitch/timing problem and some pops and stray static, though the track stitching has been improved (no interruptions on China Cat Sunflower, Rider or Good Lovin'). Musically the show shines with an intimate acoustic set, a powerful The Other One flowing into a fiery Lovelight, plus memorable Friend of the Devil and Katie Mae performances.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews are overwhelmingly positive about the performance (standout acoustic set, The Other One, Lovelight) with only minor technical complaints about pitch and noise; weighted scoring yields a strong 4.2.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Half‑step low/slow pitch issue noted, occasional pops, crackles and stray static, but overall clear; track continuity improved (no breaks on China Cat Sunflower, Rider, Good Lovin', The Other One is a single track).

show_quality.setlist_flow: Includes a well‑received acoustic set that opens with Friend of the Devil, smooth transitions after fixing track splits, and a high‑energy finish with The Other One into Lovelight.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia improves lyrics on the acoustic Friend of the Devil and shines in the intimate acoustic setting.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums in Good Lovin' are uninterrupted and sound solid.
